name: long_options_standalone
verdict: First options structure with a real right tail (TSLA P(10x)=7.3%), but no alpha: calls-only beat signal-directed in all 12 paired configs. Measured WITHOUT commissions or slippage and without the RiskManager.
notes: Reference implementation retained so the reported v9 numbers stay reproducible. Superseded by strategies/active/long_options.py, which routes the identical selection logic through the shared risk and cost layers.
